bio: Bedruthan Hotel & Spa is nestled in the cliffs of Mawgan Porth on the north Cornish coast. Inspired by Scandi-style design, you will find bright colours and bold patterns around the hotel.  Afternoon Tea at Bedruthan is hosted in the Herring restaurant, an intimate and cosy space with spectacular views of the North Cornwall coastline. The chefs carefully curate menus using locally sourced produce and seasonal flavours.  The Afternoon Tea menu changes with the seasons and availability of local sourced ingredients.  Afternoon Tea is served every day from 2pm to 3.45pm and costs £25 per person.
